This is an environment/tooling failure, not evidence the code is absent, so I cannot claim not-present. I also cannot cite any guard (already-guarded), and all files the finding cites (calculator.ts, cell-index.ts, store/memory.ts, frontend yorkie-store.ts) appear on the authoritative changed-file list, so pre-existing does not apply. The claim is squarely in the blast-radius lane as stated: a changed expansion contract whose out-of-diff consumers (buildDependantsMap in two packages) depend on an acyclicity invariant, which if real is a major violated invariant producing a spurious cycle/#REF! or recalculation loop. Refuting requires a named ground plus locations I actually read; I read none, so under the "unsure keeps the finding" rule this stays confirmed.
